evidence_policy.existing_fixture: Coverage pointer, not proof every scenario option is tested or passed. related-not-oracle means an explicit new fixture/extension is required.
evidence_policy.execution: No per-case operation run, competitor comparison, Electron or shipped-desktop qualification is claimed. See VERIFICATION.md for bounded commands actually executed.
evidence_policy.version: Installed 5.4 manual/static metadata, live public manuals and 6.0 release-history entry stay distinct. No purchase, install or later-version target expansion.
evidence_policy.expectations: Counts/metrics name independent fixtures where known; unspecified baseline semantics are follow-up investigations, never invented result counts.
